# alphaTab 1.8.4

Used only to write Guitar Pro 7/8 files (`.gp`) from the riff editor (see `js/export/guitar-pro.js`).
The file is loaded on demand when the user presses the export button, so it does not affect page load.

- Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@coderline/alphatab (unmodified `dist/alphaTab.min.js`)
- Project: https://github.com/CoderLine/alphaTab
